blockers.detail: Two layers: (a) Developer Tools registration requires 'an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher'; (b) 'The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans' (the introduction lists Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management). Your customers' users must be on qualifying plans too.
blockers.howToClear: Confirm your own plan before registering and set customer expectations: free/trial-plan users cannot connect.
blockers.title: Business-plan gate (you and your users)

blockers.detail: 17 scopes, requested per authorization, each broad: READ_SHEETS is 'Read ALL sheet data, including attachments, discussions, and cell data' for that user; ADMIN_* scopes modify org structure and users. There is no per-sheet or finer granularity.
blockers.howToClear: Request the minimum scope set per feature and explain the breadth honestly on your connect screen.
blockers.title: Coarse, account-wide scopes

blockers.detail: Base URLs differ (api.smartsheet.com / .eu / .au, plus Smartsheet Gov), and 'Smartsheet Gov and Smartsheet Regions Europe use separate tokens from Smartsheet.com'. The OpenAPI spec's OAuth scheme lists only the US authorize/token URLs.
blockers.howToClear: Plan per-region app/token handling from the start if you serve EU or Gov customers.
blockers.title: Regions are separate worlds

alternatives: Personal API access token generated in the Smartsheet UI (your own/machine-to-machine use; not for customers connecting their accounts)
flavor.recommended: A third-party application registered in Developer Tools, standard OAuth 2.0 authorization-code (3-legged) flow
flavor.why: Registration yields a client ID and app secret. The Authentication guide: 'If your scenario involves user consent and interaction, it's typically best to use OAuth with Smartsheet. Note that the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention.' Endpoints (from the official OpenAPI spec): authorize at app.smartsheet.com/b/authorize, token at api.smartsheet.com/2.0/token.

humanMust: Register for Developer Tools as a licensed Business-plan-or-higher user (submitting agrees to the Smartsheet Developer Agreement)
Register the app and custody the app secret
Each connecting user clicks 'Allow' in the web UI; the human step is by design
name: Smartsheet
nuances: Non-standard client authentication option: besides client_secret, the token endpoint accepts hash = SHA-256 of 'app_secret|code' (or 'app_secret|refresh_token' on refresh). OAuth libraries won't do this by default; the plain-secret option exists, so standard libraries still work.

Access tokens default to just under 7 days (expires_in default 604799 seconds per the spec's Token schema). Refresh tokens are first-class, and DELETE /2.0/token revokes one token or, with deleteAllForApiClient=true, all tokens for a client ID + user ID.
Webhooks can be app-scoped: the webhook subscription schema carries an appClientId and a scopes field, tying app-created webhooks to the registering app.
An optional smartsheet-integration-source header (TYPE,OrgName,SourceName, e.g. 'AI,SampleOrg,My-AI-Connector-v2') is documented for distinguishing third-party/AI-connector calls.
prerequisites: A licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher (Developer Tools registration gate)
Agreement to the Smartsheet Developer Agreement at registration
A registered redirect URI on the app

steps.detail: At developers.smartsheet.com/register. Gate: 'The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher.' Submitting the form means agreeing to the Smartsheet Developer Agreement.
steps.title: Register for Developer Tools

steps.detail: In the Smartsheet UI via Developer Tools; Smartsheet assigns the client ID and app secret, and a redirect URI is registered on the app.
steps.title: Register the app in Developer Tools

steps.detail: Redirect the user to app.smartsheet.com/b/authorize; the user logs in and clicks 'Allow', and Smartsheet returns an authorization code. Each connecting user authorizes in the web UI; there is no way around the human step by design.
steps.title: Send the user to authorize

steps.detail: POST api.smartsheet.com/2.0/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) with grant_type=authorization_code, code, client_id, and either client_secret or hash = SHA-256(app_secret|code). Response: access_token, token_type bearer, expires_in (default 604799, just under 7 days), refresh_token.
steps.title: Exchange the code

steps.detail: Refresh at the same endpoint with grant_type=refresh_token and client_secret or hash = SHA-256(app_secret|refresh_token). Revoke with DELETE /2.0/token (optionally deleteAllForApiClient=true). Remember regions use separate tokens.
steps.title: Refresh and revoke

tagline: Standard 3-legged OAuth with no review, gated instead by plans: you need a Business-plan license to register, your customers need Business or Enterprise to connect, and the 17 scopes are coarse and account-wide.

time.active: ~20 min of registration + ~1-2 hrs of flow code
time.total: Same day; no review documented in front of users
